completion_definition: 30-step/end-point collection plus restoration protection only; residuals/shape/render may fail or remain Unknown; accepted is always false
scope: Frozen failing pose static-preview candidate only; no original Cloth/action timeline advances, artist application or Body-volume proof.

runtime_differences.scope: This motion run is a new compatibility validation; the old install did not validate changed code

install_input.scope: This new run validates current-runtime compatibility; the old install did not validate changed code

saved_cache_preflight.policy: Refuse any pre-existing sealed, disk, external or baking cache; no artist cache files are enumerated or touched
saved_cache_preflight.reason: Only an unsealed native RAM cache is present; all later disk/cache operations use QA candidate paths

registered_body.definition: Actual evaluated registered Body, with Dress samples in native pelvis-to-knee projection interval

body_collision_comparison.scope: Same depsgraph actual mesh readback, exact native IDs/topology/points compared. Shared data/binding does not substitute for this measurement; lock/group differences are independent diagnostics.

input_visibility.scope: Observed native flags only. Explicit collision collection, object hiding and collection filtering remain distinct; no collision-enabled or visibility repair inferred.

private_cache_policy: Only this new candidate's source/preview caches; no free_bake call. Exact new helper ID deletion releases its runtime cache; isolated disk files retained as private QA evidence. Artist/input cache refused if sealed/external/disk.

private_visibility.scope: Observed native flags only. Explicit collision collection, object hiding and collection filtering remain distinct; no collision-enabled or visibility repair inferred.
